mechanism_narrative: A higher level of monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust residential construction activity, which typically signals strong consumer spending and business investment, leading to improved corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces corporate borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 280) and a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) indicates a monetary policy response to overheating, which typically causes equity market sell-offs due to higher discount rates and reduced real earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals the onset of economic contraction, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and UNRATE < 4.0% at the time of the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 104.0) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which typically reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 104.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of monthly non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions, which typically supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST > 1750) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 660000) indicates a robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum over a 3-month period signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (3-month average).
